headline: iOS 27: AI features to automate tasks, split bills, and secure passwords
summary: Apple is integrating AI across its existing apps and services in iOS 27, focusing on practical problem-solving rather than just a revamped Siri.
details: iOS 27 is set to introduce a suite of AI-powered features designed to enhance user experience and automate everyday tasks. These enhancements are being woven into the apps and services users already interact with, aiming to make the software feel smarter and more capable.

One notable feature is the ability to split restaurant bills using Apple Cash. By taking a photo of a receipt, Apple Intelligence can extract item details, allowing users to easily divide costs among friends and send payment requests.

Security is also getting an AI boost. iOS 27 will identify weak or compromised passwords from data breaches and automatically navigate websites to update them with more secure versions, a significant step beyond manual password management.

The Messages app will offer intelligent one-tap suggestions based on conversation context. This could include adding requests to reminders, suggesting relevant photos to share, or prompting to add events to the Calendar.

Customer service calls are also set to become less stressful with the new Call Context feature. It will leverage Apple Intelligence to pull necessary information, such as airline confirmation codes, directly from emails and display it on the call screen.
